items._note: WEST BATH (x 20.0833..31, z -1..6). Shower on the NORTH wall (x 24..27.5), shallow 2.5 ft depth since the room is only ~7 ft N-S. Toilet in the west bay BETWEEN the west wall (x31) and the shower's west edge (x27.5), facing S with ~21 in clearance each side. Vanity in the SE corner (faces N). All clear of the entry-door swing.

WC EAST WALL, centred 6 in EAST of the shower's east face (-17.729 vs -17.229), so the room is 6 in deeper than a wall flush with the shower would make it (clear 5.27 ft, inner face -17.5). Flush was tried first and the north wall then had 4.77 ft for a pocket door that needs leaf 2.5 + pocket 2.33 + casing 0.33; the owner chose to deepen the room rather than narrow the door. Runs from the shower's north face (pz -3.688) to under the north wall's end (-0.23). Level top at the raked ceiling there (z(-17.729) = 8.432).

WC NORTH WALL at pz -0.459 (north face -0.23, leaving 0.83 ft to the bedroom door's south jamb for its casing), from the bedroom wall's face (-12.229) across the east partition's end (-17.958). Its top RAKES with the shed ceiling: topFt = z(px) at both ends. The 30 in POCKET door (edges -17.07..-14.57) is built from the west jamb and slides west into the wall toward the bedroom door: 2.34 ft of pocket for a leaf that leaves 2 in of pull showing, and its east casing (0.33) clears the WC's inner east face (-17.5) by 0.10. Owner's choice: the room is 3 ft wide, too small to swing a leaf inward.

WATER CLOSET toilet, a conventional tank, on the WEST wall inside the WC north of the shower: the anchor sits 1.1 ft in front of the wall face (-12.229; buildToilet's tank runs -1.1..-0.6), centred in the 3 ft clear width (pz -3.688..-0.688), 15 in each side; the bowl's front (-14.229) leaves 3 ft 3 in to the WC's east wall face (-17.5).

77-inch TV on the east wall facing W toward the sofa (screenFt = 5.6 ft wide, 16:9 -> ~3.15 ft tall -> 6.42 ft / 77 in diagonal), on a 6 ft media console.

PRIMARY EN-SUITE (extension x -22.92..-12, z -11.92..4), one open room. DOOR near the NW corner on the west wall. Double VANITY on the EAST wall centred on the north-east window (z -0.74), a sink and mirror either side of the glass, sconces outboard, counter at 34 in under the sill. Double SHOWER along the WEST wall, 8 x 5 ft, long side on the bedroom partition, two heads on that wall, a 6 ft SEGMENTAL arched doorless entry facing the room (springs at 6 ft 3, rises 1 ft 9 — a semicircle would apex above the ceiling). Five feet deep so that the west south transom (px -14.73) is CENTRED in its south end wall, equal tile either side, and is cut out of it (side cutout, da = (px_window - px_shower) * A[0] for a shower opening E). Wall-hung TOILET on the south wall near the SE corner under the east transom, facing north. No WC room. The ceiling over the shower rakes 8.47..8.89 (see level2 slopedCeiling), so the tile stops LEVEL at 8.4, just under its lowest point, with the raked plaster above — the usual detail; the tile does not rake.

WATER CLOSET toilet, a conventional tank, on the WEST wall inside the WC north of the shower: the anchor sits 1.1 ft in front of the wall face (-12.229; buildToilet's tank runs -1.1..-0.6), centred in the 3 ft clear width (pz -3.688..-0.688), 15 in each side; the bowl's front (-14.229) leaves 2 ft 9 in to the WC's east wall face (-17.0).

En-suite lighting, kept simple: the vanity's own two sconces (`sconces: true` on the vanity item), two recessed over the shower (2.7 ft off its end walls), one in the WC over the toilet, two along the entry. Each of the two ground-room boxes this level reuses holds a fixture, so no generic ceiling light appears. Each can's ceilFt is the raked ceiling at its px: 8.0 + 0.0833 * (px + 22.9167).
